description: This file provides export functionalities for notes and attachments in the Notesnook project, including exporting notes to various formats (txt, pdf, md, html), handling attachments, creating zip archives, and managing file system interactions on iOS and Android.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Determines and creates the export directory path based on platform and type.

methods.name: unlockVaultForNoteExport
methods.description: Unlocks the vault for exporting notes.

methods.name: copyFileAsync
methods.description: Copies a file asynchronously using ScopedStorage.

methods.name: resolveFileFunctions
methods.description: Resolves and prepares file system functions for exporting in specified format.

methods.name: exportNoteToFile
methods.description: Exports a single note to a file in the specified format.

methods.name: exportAttachmentToFile
methods.description: Exports an attachment to the cache folder.

methods.name: bulkExport
methods.description: Exports multiple notes and attachments to a zip archive in specified format.

methods.name: exportNote
methods.description: Exports a single note, including attachments, to specified format.

methods.name: createZip
methods.description: Creates a zip archive of exported files.

methods.name: createFile
methods.description: Creates a single exported file for a note.
